name: Albania

flag.description: A red field with a black double-headed eagle in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Red stands for bravery, strength and the blood of patriots; the double-headed eagle comes from the seal of the 15th-century national hero Skanderbeg.

hook: A black double-headed eagle spread across a blood-red field: Albania's eagle is black and borderless, while Montenegro's is gold inside a gold frame.
trivia: Albanians call their country Shqipëri, a name popularly linked to the word for eagle, giving it the nickname 'Land of the Eagles'.
The flag was raised in Vlorë on 28 November 1912 when Ismail Qemali declared Albania's independence from the Ottoman Empire.
